div.div: 4 أَتْأَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ النَّظَرَ I continued to look at him time after time (تَارَةً بَعْدَ تَارَةٍ): (T, TA:) or I looked at him sharply, or intently. (Fr, T, M, K.) And أَتْأَرْتُهُ بَصَرِى, (T, S, M, K,) and أَتْأَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ البَصَرَ, (K,) I followed him with my eye; made my eye to follow him. (S, M, K.) [See also art. تور.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
